name: Filipino Pork Giniling with Rice and Boiled Egg

components.name: Pork Giniling
steps: In a deep pan, sauté crushed garlic in oil until lightly golden; add diced onion and cook until soft.
Brown the ground pork for about five minutes, breaking it into crumbs.
Add pork bouillon, tomato sauce and 240 ml water; simmer 20 minutes to develop flavour.
Add potatoes and carrots; simmer another 10 to 12 minutes until tender. Season with sugar, measured salt and pepper.

components.name: Jasmine Rice
steps: Cook rinsed jasmine rice separately using 490 ml water; rest and fluff.

components.name: Boiled Egg
steps: Place four eggs in simmering water and cook until hard-boiled, then chill and peel. For freezing portions, leave eggs out until serving.
Top servings with prepared egg if appropriate, and pack with rice. Freeze giniling without egg.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
CONTAINS PORK; NOT HALAL. Source 6 servings and four optional eggs. UNHANGRY adds rice and includes four eggs; macros divided by six. Egg amount can be scaled separately in Family Hub.
Storing & reheating: Freeze cooked pork tomato sauce without eggs; potatoes may soften. Add boiled eggs fresh or store chilled for earlier-week portions.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
